hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -n "${STAR_FORGE_SCRIPT:-}" ] && [ -f "$STAR_FORGE_SCRIPT" ]; then python3 "$STAR_FORGE_SCRIPT" session-start-hook; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/star_forge.py" ]; then python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/star_forge.py" session-start-hook; exit 0; fi; best=""; bestv=""; for p in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/star-forge/*/scripts/star_forge.py; do [ -f "$p" ] || continue; v=$(basename "$(dirname "$(dirname "$p")")"); newest=$(printf "%s\n%s\n" "$bestv" "$v" | sort -V | tail -1); if [ -z "$bestv" ] || [ "$newest" = "$v" ]; then best="$p"; bestv="$v"; fi; done; if [ -n "$best" ]; then python3 "$best" session-start-hook; else echo "star-forge: helper script not found; hooks inactive" >&2; fi; exit 0'
